# Code of Conduct

What does being a volunteer mean?

Being a volunteer means more than simply giving up your time.

When you volunteer for Alnwick Dolphins, you become part of the team representing the club.
That means we ask all volunteers to:

- act in the best interests of swimmers;
- treat everyone with respect;
- follow club policies and procedures;
- maintain appropriate boundaries;
- communicate appropriately;
- work cooperatively with coaches and other volunteers;
- respect confidentiality;
- raise concerns through the appropriate channels;
- provide a positive example to swimmers.

You are not expected to know everything.
You are expected to ask when you are unsure.

You can view the most up to date versions of our codes of contuct on [Swim Manager](https://alnwickdol.swimmanager.co.uk/club_policies).
